w: After lunch Swamishri blessed some devotees and officials. The General Manager of Telecom, Ahmedabad district, Shri A. K. Saxena, had come for Swamishri’s darshan. Swamishri said that he had met the Saheb before. But a sadhu added that he has come for the first time. However Swamishri was sure that he had met him before and so tried to recall where he had met the General Manager. A sadhu replied that Swamishri had met another Telecom Manager. But Swamishri confidently said, "No, it was not him, it was Saxena Saheb we had met...."

Mr. Saxena was amazed with Swamishri’s memory and added, "I had come for Swamishri’s darshan three years ago..." Swamishri blessed Mr. Saxena with success and happiness in life. Everyone else were left simply amazed by Swamishri’s sharp memory.

ph: Addressing an assembly of parents, Sarangpur

w: Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha rituals of murtis for the hari mandirs in the towns of Ramol and Virol.
At 6.30 p.m., Swamishri attended the annual day special program by satsangi students of APC. They performed bhajans and a drama called 'Mrutunjay'. Finally, Swamishri blessed the assembly.
After Swamishri's morning puja, the birthday assembly of Brahmaswarup Bhagatji Maharaj following speeches by senior sadhus, Swamishri blessed the assembly.

Today, Children’s Day and symbolic rangotsav were celebrated in Swamishri’s puja. Firstly, BAPS children sang bhajans during puja. The stage was decorated with vats of coloured water, bowls of gulal and coloured powder and pichkaris. In the end Swamishri blessed the assembly, “Hold ghar sabha daily. Just as one accomplishes one’s worldly works together, similarly ghar sabha should be held for the liberation of one’s soul. Through it one attains knowledge, understanding, bhakti and the blessings of the satpurush.” Around 6.00 p.m. Swamishri departed from Bhavnagar and mid-way towards Sarangpur he observed the mandir construction at Vallabhipur. At 7.00 p.m. Swamishri arrived in Sarangpur amidst a warm welcome. After having darshan at the Yagnapurush Smruti Mandir, he proceeded towards the mandir for Thakorji’s darshan. On the way Swamishri blessed all sadhus and devotees.
Doing darshan, Swamishri came into the rupchoki of the mandir. The sadhus and parshads gathered here were doing Swamishri's darshan.
Meanwhile Swamishri coughed. Ruda Swami said, "Give the cough to us."

Swamishri said, "I sit in this chair and get around sitting down. It is not good for you to get a cough. May you not get a cough, may you not get fever, may your mind not fall ill. If the sadhus travel, the work gets done. We just sit here."
